external_collaboration.evidence_quote: From the outset, BGO and 105 Victoria Street have embraced a Social Impact mission, forming partnerships with charities, social enterprises, local community groups and schools alike. Our aim has been to integrate community into the development and to ensure that its social impact legacy continues long into the future. Key partnerships include Westminster Wheels, Mind, Wondering Minds, Cardinal Hume, The Greycoat Hospital School, St. Matthews Primary School, Westminster City School, Greenhouse Sp
